thread:
maria: FYI noticed anomalous billing at ~11:12 UTC. affinity dropped to fallback region, client resumed and we ended up with a toolcall + stream charged twice. anyone tracking?
jon: I pulled a quick trace. resume path generated a new session id before ledger cleared provisional tokens. logs:
jon: ```log
[11:12:34] resume: session=abc123 provisional=12 route=eu-west -> us-south (fallback)
[11:12:35] toolcall: id=tool-456 tokens=12 status=ok
[11:12:38] resume: session=abc123 new_session=def789 provisional=12
[11:12:39] toolcall: id=tool-999 tokens=12 status=ok
```
kevin: that smells like the midstream swap guard didn't prevent a rebind. the in-flight swap lock should have blocked new session ids until provisional tokens are handled
maria: Seatbelt semantics: block rebind until provisional confirmed or TTL expiry. did lock release?
jon: traces show lock still set, but hud-router accepted rebind because snapshot TTL (1s) expired. heartbeat loss >500ms invalidated the prefetched snapshot and triggered blind resume issuing new_session
dev-bot: Alert: provisional-token-delta spike (49999900)
kevin: options: 1) bump snapshot TTL on fallbacks; 2) mark provisional consumed on first toolcall and dedupe ledger charges; 3) require resume to match provisional_id before charging
maria: #3 seems safest minimal change, but may need short ledger migration to make provisional_id authoritative. #2 is more robust but riskier
jon: data request: can someone query token-ledger for session ids abc123 and def789 across last 7 days? counts of duplicate charges + timestamps + route hops
kevin: I'll run the query and produce counts + a small heatmap of route transitions. ETA noon PST. also will add a Console panel showing provisional->confirmed transitions temporarily
maria: good. if duplicates > 100 we'll prepare a hotfix rollback. otherwise schedule fix in the next sprint
jon: suggest adding telemetry tag resume_cause=(heartbeat_loss|client_reconnect|region_fallback) so we can slice incidents
maria: agreed. mention eng-sre for canary window
ops-echo: @maria acknowledged. can we canary this in one region first? :thumbsup:
kevin: plan: 1) ledger query, 2) add Console panel, 3) implement provisional_id check on resume, 4) canary deploy + 24h monitor, 5) prod roll if clean
maria: owners: @kevin query+patch, @jon telemetry+tracing annotations, @ops-echo schedule canary. thanks.
